import.noR5: No R5 in this paste — the alliance leader is missing or the paste is partial.
import.manyR5: {{n}} rows claim R5 — an alliance has exactly one leader, so check the paste.
import.title: Import roster (TSV)
import.desc: Paste the in-game Alliance Ranking screen. Matched names update existing members; unrecognized names and absent members are decided one by one. Identity is never guessed and absence is never read as departure.
import.result: Updated <1>{{updated}}</1> · Created <2>{{created}}</2> · Aliased <3>{{aliased}}</3> · Deactivated <4>{{deactivated}}</4> · Reactivated <5>{{reactivated}}</5> · Skipped <6>{{skipped}}</6> · Recomputed <7>{{recomputed}}</7> participations.
import.captureDateHelp: The day this Alliance Ranking screen was captured. Rank and power are recorded against it, so the next import can report what changed.
import.rosterHelp: One member per line, tab-separated, columns in this exact order: <1>Governor</1> · <2>Rank</2> · <3>Power</3> · <4>Position</4>. Rank is the R-level badge (R1–R5); Position is the leaderboard number on the left of the row. Keep all four columns even when a cell is empty. Power may include commas (stripped). Use the LLM prompt below to turn the screenshots into this format.
import.matched_one: <1>{{count}}</1> row matches existing members (will update Rank/Power/Position)
import.matched_other: <1>{{count}}</1> rows match existing members (will update Rank/Power/Position)
import.invalidRows_one: {{count}} row has an unreadable cell. Fix the paste — nothing is imported until they are gone.
import.invalidRows_other: {{count}} rows have an unreadable cell. Fix the paste — nothing is imported until they are gone.
import.conflicts_one: {{count}} member is named more than once in this capture. A member can only be observed once per date.
import.conflicts_other: {{count}} members are named more than once in this capture. A member can only be observed once per date.
import.existing_one: <1>{{date}}</1> already holds <2>{{count}}</2> snapshot; this paste carries <3>{{carries}}</3>. Importing replaces that date wholesale — members not in this paste lose their observation for it.
import.existing_other: <1>{{date}}</1> already holds <2>{{count}}</2> snapshots; this paste carries <3>{{carries}}</3>. Importing replaces that date wholesale — members not in this paste lose their observation for it.
import.futureDate: <1>{{date}}</1> is in the future. A capture on a wrong date cannot be removed from the app — check the date before applying.
import.checkFailed: Could not check whether <1>{{date}}</1> already has a capture. If it does, importing replaces it wholesale.
import.step2Intro: Unrecognized names may be existing members who renamed. Map them to the right member as an <1>alias</1>, add as a <2>new member</2>, or <3>skip</3>. Names are never auto-created.
import.name: Name
import.promoteHelp: Ticking <1>{{label}}</1> renames the member: the pasted name becomes their governor and the old name is kept as an alias. Leave it off unless you know this is a rename — the alliance runs decoy renames where similar names are different people.
import.pickMember: Pick a member for every “{{label}}” row before continuing.
import.conflictsStep2: Two names now point at the same member ({{names}}). A member can only be observed once per capture.
import.backfill: Backfilling {{date}} — newest capture on record is {{latest}}. Membership is left alone: who was in the alliance then says nothing about who is in it now. Power, position and rank are recorded for this date. Anyone seen in a later capture keeps their newer standing; anyone this paste is the most recent word on has theirs updated.
import.step3Intro: These members' membership is not settled by the paste. Absence is <1>not</1> treated as departure — tick only the members you know have left.
import.partialPaste: <1>{{absent}}</1> of <2>{{active}}</2> active members are missing from this paste. The Alliance Ranking screen scrolls — check you captured all of it before deactivating anyone.
import.returningTitle: Inactive but present in this capture ({{n}})
